facts.fact: The e-Government Act (Cap. 273, Act No. 10 of 2019, an act of parliament) commenced on 19 September 2019 (GN No. 964 of 2019) and applies to all public institutions; its Part VIII, Electronic Government Data Management, has a section 48 headed Data sharing and exchange and it defines interoperability as systems exchanging data, though the section text is not held and the date is the Act's commencement.

systems.owner: Parliament; administered by the e-Government Authority

note: Text of ss.47-49 is not held, so nothing states that the Act obliges public bodies to exchange data or that it has been applied.
